The seam and the span are right and I do not contest them: oshb:Ps.89.39 (= web:Ps.89.38) opens with a vav plus fronted independent pronoun, וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס, collating at BYTE tier as the row quotes it, and the unit closes on the selah verse oshb:Ps.89.46, which pmarks_Ps.json records with 1 occurrence, as it does oshb:Ps.89.38. Correcting the continuity claim strengthens rather than weakens the boundary, which is why the span survives the challenge.
